title: Allowing Seniors to Purchase Hearing Aids with MediSave
what_it_is: Allowing Seniors to Purchase Hearing Aids with MediSave

sections.label: MediSave for hearing aids
sections.summary: The Ministry will not allow seniors to use MediSave for hearing aids, though implants can tap subsidies, MediSave and MediShield Life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health in view of studies linking uncorrected hearing loss with dementia, whether the Ministry will consider allowing seniors to use MediSave for the purchase of their hearing aids.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Those with severe hearing loss requiring hearing implants, such as bone conduction hearing or cochlear implants, can tap on subsidies, MediSave and MediShield Life.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) can also provide additional support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: While it is understandable that many Singaporeans wish to use more of their MediSave, we also need to ensure that Singaporeans have adequate MediSave balances to support their medical expenses for major health episodes, which tend to happen when they are in an advanced age.

sections.label: Seniors' MediSave Fund eligibility
sections.summary: Over 16,000 seniors applied for the fund since 2019 and 99% are eligible, with AIC support for those who are not.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I note the concern that the Member raised on the limitations of the SMF.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I would say though that there are over 16,000 seniors since 2019, I believe, who have already applied for this fund and most of them will actually get subsidies; 99% of them are eligible and actually would get the subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, for those of them who cannot meet the eligibility requirement, they can go to AIC for any additional support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I note the Member's concerns, but I think it is a balancing exercise that we have to take note of.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is something that we will constantly review and assess because there is a need to also ensure that there are sufficient balances in MediSave.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We take into account how we reserve this for the more severe situations and more costly items.

sections.label: AIC support for seniors
sections.summary: Seniors who cannot afford it and do not meet SMF eligibility can approach AIC for other support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As I said, if there are situations where the seniors feel that they actually cannot afford it and do not meet the SMF eligibility requirements, they can approach AIC and we can see what are some of the other ways that we can support the seniors.
